title: loasa triphylla subsp. rudis
intro: Loasa triphylla subsp. rudis, commonly known as the "Rudis Loasa" or "Himalayan Loasa", is a plant species belonging to the Loasaceae family. It is a shrub-like plant native to the Himalayan region, known for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Loasa triphylla subsp. rudis include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal value and potential use in traditional medicine.
